symptom: `brain plan` and `brain check` fail with `CONNECT LOCAL '…/App.mpr': failed to connect: mpr file not found` when the brain was started before the project, although init/capture/promote/brief all work against the same nonexistent -p path
cause: Both commands call `openBrainResolver(projectPath)` and `brainFatal` on any error; the store commands only ever use `filepath.Dir` of -p
insight: **A null resolver needs its own state, and the existing state switch silently decides what it means.** Returning NotFound reports the whole store stale; adding a state without touching `checkSlice` is worse, because that branch counts every non-NotFound state as BUILT (so NotIndexable does not under-report) — a project that does not exist read 100% built. The test asserts Built 0, not just exit 0; stubbing the guard gives Built:1. Only os.IsNotExist selects NoModel: a corrupt .mpr still errors, or it would read as merely unbuilt. Verified end to end: same store, `-p Nothing.mpr` 0 of 1, `-p PedApp.mpr` 1 of 1
